metadata.purpose: Implement the missing deterministic Scene CreateIK planning/composition slice after 161z proved the verification route only checks anchors.
metadata.instruction: Create aimayatool/tools/scene/create_ik.py and create_ik_python_smoke.py. Pure planning must require exactly three unique source names and exactly three XYZ positions, reject collinear geometry, compute deterministic normalized chain direction, plane normal and pole-vector position, and return stable names/options. Keep Maya imports behind execution boundaries. Reuse setup.transforms, setup.controls, setup.ikfk and setup.spaces at the host composition boundary; do not copy their implementations. Do not introduce NLTA, PyMEL, UI, reload, or legacy JSON dependencies. Run py_compile, import smoke and focused unittest for the new files, then commit/push. If this route cannot create files, return an explicit capability mismatch rather than reporting success from anchor compilation. Do not use Codex.
acceptance: Both new Scene CreateIK files exist in main after the task.
Exactly-three and duplicate validation are covered.
Valid non-collinear geometry yields deterministic plane/pole data.
Collinear geometry is rejected before Maya mutation.
Setup primitives are imported/composed, not duplicated.
Both new modules compile/import and focused unittest passes.
Product/test changes are committed and pushed.
